description: Summary figure and provenance tables: LRP5L architecture, ORF status across primates, dN/dS, and the two defining frameshifts
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyBboxPatch
import pandas as pd

orf=json.load(open("primate_ORFs.json"))
dn=json.load(open("dnds_hominoid.json"))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.0,1.15,1.1],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.25)

# ---------------- Panel A: architecture ----------------
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
axA.set_xlim(-30,1680); axA.set_ylim(-1.6,2.3); axA.axis("off")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((1,1.25),1615,0.42,fc="#e8e8ef",ec="#55556a",lw=1))
prop=[(42,386),(387,628),(645,890),(900,1145)]
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(prop):
    axA.add_patch(Rectangle((a,1.25),b-a,0.42,fc="#4c72b0",ec="#2a3f63",lw=0.8))
    axA.text((a+b)/2,1.46,f"YWTD propeller {i+1}",ha="center",va="center",color="w",fontsize=7.5)
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((1,1.25),30,0.42,fc="#d62728",ec="k",lw=0.6))
axA.text(15,1.95,"signal\npeptide",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#d62728")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((1385,1.25),23,0.42,fc="#2ca02c",ec="k",lw=0.6))
axA.text(1397,1.95,"TM",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#2ca02c")
axA.text(1500,1.46,"cytoplasmic",ha="center",fontsize=7)
axA.text(-20,1.46,"LRP5\n1615 aa",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")

axA.plot([383,383],[1.2,0.72],color="grey",lw=0.8,ls=":")
axA.plot([613,613],[1.2,0.72],color="grey",lw=0.8,ls=":")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((383,0.3),231,0.42,fc="#4c72b0",ec="#2a3f63",lw=0.8,alpha=0.85))
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((614,0.3),21,0.42,fc="#ff7f0e",ec="k",lw=0.8))
axA.text(498,0.51,"LRP5L aa 1-231 = LRP5 aa 383-613 (83.5% aa identity)",ha="center",va="center",color="w",fontsize=8)
axA.text(760,0.51,"aa 232-252: no LRP5 counterpart",ha="left",va="center",color="#b35900",fontsize=8)
axA.annotate("", xy=(640,0.18), xytext=(700,-0.35), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-",color="#b35900",lw=0.8))
axA.text(705,-0.5,"1-nt deletion vs LRP5 at LRP5L codon 230 shifts the frame\nand creates a stop 22 codons later",
         fontsize=8,color="#b35900",va="center")
axA.text(-20,0.51,"LRP5L (A4QPB2)\n252 aa",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
axA.text(383,-1.15,"only 5 of the 6 propeller blades, no signal peptide, no EGF module, no LDLa repeats, no transmembrane segment",
         fontsize=8.5,color="#333333")
axA.set_title("A. LRP5L is an internal fragment of the LRP5 second YWTD propeller", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

# ---------------- Panel B: ORF integrity ----------------
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
species=["Human","Chimpanzee","Bonobo","Gorilla","Siamang (gibbon)","Orangutan (2 assemblies)","Rhesus macaque"]
status =["ORF intact","ORF intact","ORF intact","frameshift + 2 stops","ORF intact","locus absent","locus absent"]
colors =["#2ca02c","#2ca02c","#2ca02c","#d62728","#2ca02c","#9e9e9e","#9e9e9e"]
sub=[0,21,22,None,51,None,None]
y=np.arange(len(species))[::-1]
for yi,st,c in zip(y,status,colors):
    axB.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.02,yi-0.3),0.96,0.6,boxstyle="round,pad=0.01",fc=c,ec="none",alpha=0.85))
for yi,(sp,st,n) in zip(y,zip(species,status,sub)):
    axB.text(0.05,yi,sp,va="center",fontsize=9,color="w",fontweight="bold")
    lab=st if n in (None,0) else f"{st} ({n} subs vs human)"
    axB.text(0.97,yi,lab,va="center",ha="right",fontsize=8.5,color="w")
axB.set_xlim(0,1); axB.set_ylim(-0.7,len(species)-0.3); axB.axis("off")
axB.set_title("B. State of the 759-nt LRP5L open reading frame", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

# ---------------- Panel C: dN/dS ----------------
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
labs=["human vs\nchimp","human vs\nbonobo","human vs\nsiamang","chimp vs\nsiamang"]
keys=["human vs chimp","human vs bonobo","human vs siamang (gibbon)","chimp vs siamang"]
om=[dn[k]["omega"] for k in keys]; ps=[dn[k]["p"] for k in keys]
bars=axC.bar(range(4),om,color=["#8aa8d0","#8aa8d0","#4c72b0","#4c72b0"],ec="k",lw=0.6,width=0.6)
axC.axhline(1.0,color="#d62728",ls="--",lw=1.2); axC.text(3.45,1.02,"neutral decay",color="#d62728",fontsize=8,ha="right")
axC.axhspan(0,0.2,color="#2ca02c",alpha=0.14)
axC.text(-0.45,0.09,"range typical of conserved\nprotein-coding genes",color="#1a6b1a",fontsize=7.5,va="center")
for i,(v,p) in enumerate(zip(om,ps)):
    axC.text(i,v+0.03,f"{v:.2f}\np={p:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axC.errorbar(0,0.653,yerr=[[0.653-0.26],[2.12-0.653]],fmt="none",ecolor="k",capsize=4,lw=1)
axC.text(0.35,1.4,"bootstrap 95% CI\n0.26 to 2.12",fontsize=7.5)
axC.set_xticks(range(4)); axC.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8.5)
axC.set_ylabel("dN/dS (Nei-Gojobori)"); axC.set_ylim(0,1.75)
axC.set_title("C. Selection on the LRP5L ORF", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

# ---------------- Panel D: alignments ----------------
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:]); axD.axis("off")
txt=[
 ("Gorilla frameshift, LRP5L codon 10 (CDS nt 29-30), seen in two independent gorilla assemblies", "#d62728"),
 ("  LRP5 parent, chr11   5'-TACTGGACAGATGACGAG..GTGCGGGCC-3'   ancestral state, no CG", "#333333"),
 ("  human   LRP5L        5'-TACTGGACGGATGACGAG--GTGTGGGCC-3'   frame open", "#333333"),
 ("  chimp   LRP5L        5'-TACTGGACGGATGACGAG--GTGTGGGCC-3'   frame open", "#333333"),
 ("  gorilla LRP5L        5'-TACTGGACGGATGACG CG AGGTGTGGGCC-3' 2-nt insertion, stops at codons 29 and 61", "#d62728"),
 ("", "#333333"),
 ("Frameshift of LRP5L relative to its LRP5 parent at LRP5L codon 230, which terminates the ORF", "#b35900"),
 ("  LRP5  chr11   GAACCAACCCGTGTGCGGACAGGAACGGGGGGTGCAGCCACCTGTGCTTCTTCACACCCCACGCAACCCGG", "#333333"),
 ("  LRP5L chr22   GAACCAACCCTCATGCGGACAGGAA-GGGGGGTGCAGCCACCTGTGCTTCTTCACGCCCCACACAACCCGG", "#b35900"),
 ("                                         ^ 1-nt deletion, after which LRP5L reads ...NGGAATCASSRPTQPGLAAPSRAWNC-stop", "#b35900"),
]
for i,(t,c) in enumerate(txt):
    axD.text(0.0,0.95-i*0.098,t,fontsize=8.6,family="monospace",color=c,
             fontweight=("bold" if i in (0,6) else "normal"),transform=axD.transAxes)
axD.set_title("D. The two frameshifts that define the locus", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
plt.show()

# provenance tables
tab=pd.DataFrame({"species":species,"assembly":["hg38 GRCh38","GCF_028858775.2 (T2T) + panTro6","GCF_029289425.2 (T2T)",
       "GCF_029281585.2 (T2T) + gorGor6","GCF_028878055.3","GCF_028885655.2 + GCF_028885625.2","rheMac10"],
   "LRP5L_locus":["present"]*5+["absent"]*2,
   "ORF_status":status,"substitutions_vs_human_ORF":[0,21,22,"n/a (frameshifted)",51,"n/a","n/a"]})
tab.to_csv("table_orf_status_by_species.csv",index=False)
pd.DataFrame([dn[k] for k in keys]).to_csv("table_dnds.csv",index=False)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
print()
print(pd.DataFrame([dn[k] for k in keys])[["label","codons","Sd","Nd","dS","dN","omega","p"]].to_string(index=False))
